snippet.title: Discovering TALE'S EDGE
snippet.description:
👉 Explore Tale’s Edge, playtests & join the WILDS → https://linktr.ee/talesedge

–

Tale’s Edge is a grounded, shared fairy-tale action-RPG in Unreal Engine, where a living world reacts, remembers, and adapts to what players do.

This video covers the game’s current technical foundation, emergent enemy AI, Unreal production systems, and the next stage of production toward a high-fidelity demo in early 2027.

–

Instagram: Red Sixteen Interactive (@r16interactive)
X: R16 Team (@r16interactive)

—
